name: Denali
tagline: North America's highest peak above wild tundra
summary: Denali National Park is six million acres of tundra, taiga and glaciers below the 6,190-metre summit of Denali. Ride the park bus into the wilderness to spot grizzlies, moose, caribou and wolves, take a flightseeing plane to land on a glacier, and meet the sled dogs at the park kennels.
seasonNote: The park road and buses run late May to mid September; the mountain hides in cloud about two days in three.
arrival: About 4 hours by car or 8 hours by the scenic Alaska Railroad from Anchorage.
gettingAround: Park buses beyond Mile 15; private cars only on the first stretch.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Alaskan salmon, halibut and reindeer sausage.
buyTip: Native Alaskan crafts and qiviut wool.
baseArea: Denali Park entrance (Glitter Gulch) or Healy
